reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis ignores that graphite oxidizes and loses lubricity above ~500 °C and MoS2 degrades above ~400 °C in air, so a lubricating film cannot persist to 800 °C under dry sliding without a protective mechanism.
reasons.testability: The proposed pin/ball-on-disk test with friction and wear measurements is clear and would decisively falsify the hypothesis if no significant reduction is observed.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a well-known approach that is physically invalid for the high-temperature end of the specified range, offering no new insight for the problem.
